
	<h1 class="postTitle"><a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/yennie/p/19708761" title="发布于 2026-03-12 15:55">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">PageCache瞬间飙升，原来是日志搞的鬼</span>
    

</a>
</h1>
	<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>问题： 16C16G的容器内存使用率（含Cache）报警，从快速上升到了70%，上涨了30%，RSS内存使用率一直很恒定在40%，相差5G。</p>
<p>背景： 日志配置了log</p>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<img alt="image" width="267" height="242" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2811507/202603/2811507-20260312152413796-691286623.png" class="lazyload">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<img alt="image" width="346" height="161" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2811507/202603/2811507-20260312153340508-1832642222.png" class="lazyload">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<img alt="image" width="299" height="173" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2811507/202603/2811507-20260312153421736-1549061462.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>结论：日志文件，正常只有一个活跃文件，会被写入Cache中。2月6日那天，我解压缩的几个历史日志文件（共5G），被写入Cache中，导致Cache涨了5G。刚才我移除这几个文件后，Cache就降下去了。</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="246" height="227" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2811507/202603/2811507-20260312152752883-1431316302.png" class="lazyload">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<img alt="image" width="245" height="162" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2811507/202603/2811507-20260312153106035-1680922485.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;移除后，PageCache里面的活跃文件也跟着下降。因为配置log规则是满3G就压缩，可能触发这个规则，logrotate周期性检测要不要压缩这些文件，导致文件被加载到PageCache，并且处于活跃文件缓存中。</p>
<p>待论证：</p>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 1. 这种情况，PageCache里面的active_file很高，如果持续增加，会不会导致oom。</p>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;通常来说，容易导致oom的主要是内存泄漏（rss）和匿名内存过多（active_anon和inactive_anon），但是如果active_file回收延迟、内存碎片增加、大块连续内存分配失败，也可能因内存无法及时释放导致oom。</p>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;todo: 找一台机器，解压缩大量日志文件，看看是否oom。</p>
<p>排查细节：</p>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;查容器内存命令：&nbsp; &nbsp;进入容器后，执行 cat&nbsp;/sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.stat &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<img alt="image" width="942" height="2088" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2811507/202603/2811507-20260312155421488-513417478.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

</div>
